name: Azure Data Explorer source connector for Eventstream
description: The Azure Data Explorer source connector for Eventstream extends ingestion limits and adds streaming from a custom query, so you can bring Azure Data Explorer data into Microsoft Fabric for further real-time processing.With this capability, you can:- Stream data from Azure Data Explorer into Eventstream.- Use a custom query to select the data you ingest.- Route results to Fabric destinations for downstream analytics.

result.nameEs: Conector de origen de Azure Data Explorer para Eventstream
result.descriptionEs: El conector de Azure Data Explorer para Eventstream amplía los límites de ingesta y permite transmitir el resultado de una consulta personalizada para seguir procesándolo en tiempo real en Fabric.
